name: Wave Assist
description: Wave-only trajectory preview and click shifting so wave inputs register on the first safe tick.

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: In wave, draws two paths ahead of you. Green: where you go if you hold/click now. Red: where you go if you let go.

trajectory-length.name: Trajectory Length (ms)
trajectory-length.description: How far ahead to predict. Longer is more expensive.

trajectory-practice-only.name: Trajectory in Practice Only
trajectory-practice-only.description: Only show the trajectory in practice mode.

smart-click.name: Enable Click Shifting
smart-click.description: In wave, scans what's in front of you before applying a press or release. Big safe area: instant. Small safe area: moved to the safest tick in the middle. Deadly right now: waits for the safest tick. Turns itself off on orbs and while dashing.

smart-max-delay.name: Max Delay (ms)
smart-max-delay.description: How far ahead to look for a safe tick. If no tick in this range is safe, your input is cancelled.

safe-gap.name: Big Safe Area (ms)
safe-gap.description: If the safe window in front of you is at least this long, your input goes through instantly. If it's shorter, your input is moved to the middle of the window (the safest tick).

smart-click-lookahead.name: Lookahead (ms)
smart-click-lookahead.description: How far ahead to check for death. Higher = safer but more cautious; lower = only reacts to deaths right in front of you.

auto-click.name: Auto Click
auto-click.description: In wave, also holds or lets go for you when your current input would kill you and the other one is safe. This plays for you: don't use it for verifying or rated runs.

smart-click-practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
smart-click-practice-only.description: Only use Click Shifting / Auto Click in practice mode.

smart-click-indicator.name: Show 'Smart Click' Label
smart-click-indicator.description: Shows a small label in the corner while Click Shifting or Auto Click is on.
